name: tok-kie
description: A friendly, local-first token & cost tracker for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity) 🐰
author: Jaewook Jung <stich9208@gmail.com>

scripts.test:unit: npm run electron:compile && node --test electron/dist/electron/app/*.test.js electron/dist/electron/cloud/*.test.js electron/dist/electron/core/test/*.test.js electron/dist/electron/ipc/*.test.js
scripts.test: npm run test:fixtures && npm run test:unit
scripts.build: npm run next:build && npm run electron:compile
scripts.pack:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:universal: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:win:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --arm64 --publish never
